pages.title: Dark Matter Lens
pages.text: A lens that focuses gravity, not light. Dark matter does not interact with photons, but its mass curves spacetime, and this lens shapes that curvature into a focal point. It looks almost empty, a faint ripple in the air, yet anything placed behind it seems drawn toward the middle.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wanted a way to concentrate the dark matter I had gathered. Wrapping it in Metamaterial Sheet around a Void Lattice Shard in the Metamaterial Weaver gave a lens that bent gravity itself into focus.
